title: Working Hours Policy
description: Employees must follow the official company working hours.
purpose: To ensure consistent attendance and clear working-hour expectations for all employees.
scope: This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and HR staff.
details: Employees are expected to arrive on time, complete their scheduled working hours, and notify their manager in case of absence or delay.
responsibilities: Employees must follow attendance rules, record working hours correctly, and communicate any delays or absences.

title: Leave Policy
description: Employees must submit leave requests through the HR system.
purpose: To provide a clear and consistent process for requesting and approving employee leave.
scope: This policy applies to all employees eligible for annual, sick, or other approved leave.
details: Employees must submit leave requests in advance through the HR system. Approval is subject to manager and HR review.
responsibilities: Employees are responsible for submitting accurate leave requests and informing their managers before the leave period.
